triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.note: The acceptance claim decomposes into: (a) the four filenames classify kind=lifecycle (CHK-001 happy, red harness green), with the closed set still rejecting unregistered/adversarial paths (CHK-001 edge+adversarial); and (b) the registry-coverage invariant runs green in the validate path, fails with a named filename when an entry is removed, and only exempts the named legacy filename (CHK-002 intents).

note: Binding maps the original-intent acceptanceClaim to both checklist items and their must-priority verification intents.
